verdict.rationale: Grok Bot runs on persistent cloud computers that hold memory, files and sessions, so data residency is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence documents choosing a storage region or residency. The "one Account Health Bot per region" example refers to business scope, not data location. Routing egress through the desktop controls web traffic, not where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
